scripts.dev:restart: docker compose down && docker compose up --build --renew-anon-volumes -d && node scripts/print-local-links.cjs
scripts.dev:db:migrate: docker compose exec backend npm run prisma:migrate -- --name init
scripts.dev:db:seed: docker compose exec backend npm run prisma:seed
scripts.dev:db:seed:demo: docker compose exec backend npm run prisma:seed:demo
scripts.dev:db:studio: docker compose exec backend npm run prisma:studio
scripts.dev:db:reset: docker compose exec backend npm run prisma:reset
scripts.lint: npm run lint:back && npm run lint:front && npm run lint:ai
scripts.lint:back: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend npm run lint
scripts.lint:front: docker compose run --rm --no-deps frontend npm run lint
scripts.lint:ai: docker compose run --rm --no-deps ai python -m ruff check .
scripts.test: npm run test:back && npm run test:front && npm run test:ai
scripts.test:back: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend npm run test
scripts.test:back:e2e: docker compose run --rm backend npm run test:e2e
scripts.e2e:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.e2e.yml up --build -d postgres-e2e backend-e2e frontend-e2e scenario-e2e
scripts.test:e2e: npm run e2e:up && npm run test:e2e:api && npm run test:e2e:ui
scripts.test:front: docker compose run --rm --no-deps frontend npm run test:ci
scripts.test:ai: docker compose run --rm --no-deps ai python -m pytest
scripts.test:ci: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:back && npm run build:front
scripts.build:back: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend npm run build
scripts.build:front: docker compose run --rm --no-deps frontend npm run build
scripts.docker:check: docker compose config && docker compose build
scripts.docker:smoke: docker compose up -d --build && docker compose ps
scripts.local:lint: npm run local:lint:back && npm run local:lint:front && npm run local:lint:ai
scripts.local:test: npm run local:test:back && npm run local:test:front && npm run local:test:ai
scripts.local:build: npm run local:build:back && npm run local:build:front
